name: Extended Form of the Dragon
body:
You can assume dragon form for much longer.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Form of the Dragon class feature.

Benefit(s): The duration of your Form of the Dragon ability increases to three minutes per level, instead of one minute per level.
